evidence: Home grid shows name/cuisine/price/rating/location/features per restaurant. Detail page (restaurant/1) shows name, cuisine (French), rating 4.5, review count (2), address, price $$$$, description, and features (Private Dining, Wine Pairing, Tasting Menu).

Search by name (Sakura), neighborhood (Downtown), cuisine keyword (Italian) each correctly narrowed results. Cuisine=Seafood + Price=$$$ narrowed to Ocean Blue only; adding search=Waterfront kept it; search=Sakura with same filters yielded 'No restaurants found matching your criteria.'

Selected Aug 26 2026, 19:00, 2 guests, filled name/email/phone, submitted. 'Reservation Confirmed!' shown, and reservation appears in Upcoming (1) with restaurant The Golden Fork, date Aug 26 2026, time 19:00, party 2 Guests.
Applied WELCOME10 -> showed '- 10% off', removed successfully, reapplied and submitted; upcoming reservation shows 'Coupon applied: WELCOME10'.
Date picker: Aug 25 (today) and all earlier August dates disabled/greyed; Aug 26 onward clickable. Selected Aug 26 + time 19:00 successfully combined into reservation.

Submitting with all fields empty did not create a reservation (Upcoming count stayed 0); Name/Email/Phone inputs are native required fields (email type=email) inside a <form> triggering browser validation and blocking submission until valid.
GROUP15 applied with party size 2 was rejected with toast 'Coupon Not Applicable - This coupon requires a party of 6 or more.' WELCOME10 applied successfully and recorded on the reservation.

issue: Coupon eligibility rules (day, first-reservation) not enforced
actual: Only the party-size rule for GROUP15 is enforced (correctly rejected with toast for party<6). WEEKEND20 (implies a weekend/day restriction) was accepted on Thursday Aug 27 and again on Monday Aug 31, both non-weekend weekdays, with no rejection. WELCOME10 was successfully applied to a second reservation for this user even though a prior reservation had already used WELCOME10, so the 'first-reservation' eligibility condition is not enforced.

issue: Modify dialog does not support changing the reservation date
actual: The 'Modify Reservation' dialog only exposes 'New Time' and 'Party Size' selects; there is no date field/control. Time and party size changes (19:00→20:00, 2→4 Guests) saved and reflected correctly in the list, but the date (August 26, 2026) cannot be changed via any UI control.

evidence: Modify dialog opened via 'Modify' button, changes to time/party size saved via 'Save Changes' and reflected in list. Cancel button (tested next) opens a separate confirmation dialog before applying.

Clicked Cancel -> confirmation dialog appeared; 'Keep Reservation' preserved it as Upcoming; re-clicked Cancel -> 'Cancel Reservation' confirm removed it from Upcoming (0) and it now appears under Past (1) with status 'Cancelled', retaining date/time/party/coupon details.

Creation showed 'Reservation Confirmed!' immediately and appeared in Upcoming without reload. Modify (time/party size) reflected instantly in the list. Cancel confirmation removed it from Upcoming and added it to Past immediately, all within the same session without any page reload.

Reservations page has separate 'Upcoming'/'Past' tabs with counts; cancelled reservation shows status 'Cancelled' under Past while active ones show 'Upcoming'. Each card displays restaurant name (The Golden Fork), date, time, party size, status, location (Downtown), and applied coupon (WELCOME10) when present.

Submitted 5-star rating, visit date 2026-08-20, name, and comment for The Golden Fork. New review appeared in that restaurant's review list (Reviews (3)) with all submitted details, and does not appear on restaurant 2's review list (which retained only its own single review).

issue: Review submission is not gated by a completed reservation
actual: Wrote and submitted a review for The Golden Fork even though the user's only reservation there had status 'Cancelled' (not completed) at the time; the review form had no restriction or error and the review was accepted and displayed. No reservation-authorization check or 'one review per completed reservation' limit was observed.

issue: Restaurant list rating/review count is inconsistent with detail page and does not update after a new review
actual: Before any new review, restaurant list showed The Golden Fork rating 4.8, while its detail page showed 4.5 (2 reviews) — already inconsistent. After submitting a 5-star review, the detail page recalculated to 4.7 (3 reviews), but the home list still displays the unchanged static 4.8, so the list summary never reflects submitted reviews.
